stories.text: 🔒 CLINCH WATCH: Brock You Like a Hurricane can lock up the #1 seed with a win over 49er Faith-Fool (100% with a win, 100% with a loss).
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: The Mahomies vs Mr. Action Jackson. Playoff odds with a win / loss: The Mahomies 37% / 10%, Mr. Action Jackson 56% / 23%.
🔒 CLINCH WATCH: Brock You Like a Hurricane can all but clinch a playoff spot with a win over 49er Faith-Fool (100% with a win, 100% with a loss).

🤝 HINDSIGHT DEPT.: 4 weeks ago we said The Mahomies should get Bo Nix and Parker Washington from Ramosverse. Since: Bo Nix and Parker Washington 108.04 pts, Devaughn Vele and Jeremiyah Love 25.80 pts.
🎤 BYE BYE BYE: Kyle Tucker has 5 starters on bye this week (Smith-Njigba, Kraft, Boston, Stafford and Browns D/ST). Time to work the waiver wire.
🎯 TWO WINS: Mr. Action Jackson: 60% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 18% with none (now 31%).
🔢 MAGIC NUMBER: Brock You Like a Hurricane clinches a first-round bye with 2 more wins. A sweep this week (beat 49er Faith-Fool and the median) does it.
🪑 The one that got away (on the bench): The Mahomies has started Ryan Flournoy just once. Starting him would have meant 3 more wins by now (Weeks 7, 8 and 10).
🤝 Rivalry week: Claremont In Yo Stace! leads Gibb it to Me Baby 4–2 all-time.
🗑️ BARGAIN BIN: The Mahomies (8-12)'s healthy bench averages 31% rostered across ESPN.
🏈 6 matchups are still up for grabs, and TDsMaGee vs Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy (Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 51%) is the tightest.
🏆 Title odds entering Week 11: Brock You Like a Hurricane 43%, Gibb it to Me Baby 15%, 49er Faith-Fool 11%.
📈 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was down to 7.2% against The Mahomies — and won.
💓 49er Faith-Fool outlasted TDsMaGee after the favorite flipped 3 times.
